title: Safe space to share your “craziest” or most abstract mallworld theories?
content: Hey, basically the title. I wanted to make a post where people can share their theories about why this place exists and why we are all going there, no matter how “crazy”! *Also, I wanted to include this but thought a separate post would be abit extra but is anybody else not at all or entirely lucid in their mallworld dreams? For me, I have experienced lucid dreaming before, but mostly when I know it’s just a dream I wake up. In mallworld, I may have a faint sense it’s not real but I have no autonomy really in the dream, it’s all playing out and I’m just rolling with the punches lol? Also, my dream is experienced in both 3rd/1st person perspective meaning I am both watching it play out like a movie but I’m also through the eyes of me, or the “character” in said movie.
